description:
I am a passionate career architect and admission strategist guiding students toward excellence in Law, Medical, Engineering, and MBA domains.
With a blend of academic insight and real-world experience, I help students navigate complex admission processes, identify their true potential, and secure seats in institutions that match their ambitions.

My counselling approach is rooted in clarity, confidence, and customised strategy — empowering every student to make informed choices and transform aspirations into achievements.
